# Locate the Panorama prototype click handler at its own source anchor

The entry1148 source-link label combined addFolderToList and the folder-list click handler under lines25–61. Those lines cover addFolderToList. The separate click handler is at110–130 of the pinned source. A click on a path-tagged folder item resolves the numeric folder ID before initializing LiveView. Use each separate anchor when following this prototype UI. This clarifies source navigation only; the original inspected behavior, evidence and audit coverage remain unchanged.

Scope: mailnews/db/panorama/content/panorama.js.
